prompt: What is the weather in Paris right now?

contents.text:
I don't have access to real-time data, so I can't tell you the current weather in Paris. However, you can check the most accurate and up-to-date information by:

- Searching "Paris weather" on Google, Bing, or Apple Weather
- Visiting a weather website like [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com), [Weather.com](https://weather.com), or [The Weather Channel](https://www.theweatherchannel.com)
- Checking local news or weather apps on your phone
